'''Evolution Mountain''' (Japanese: '''進化山''' ''Evolution Mountain'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive mountain located in between the {{safari|Kanto}} and [[Cinnabar Island]]. At its base lies [[Stone Town]]. Evolution Mountain is famous for the [[Evolution stone]]s that can be found there.
